450 U. S. 382 and 451 U. S. 964. Motion for leave to file second petition for rehearing denied.

An order of The Chief Justice designating and assigning Justice Stewart (retired) to perform judicial duties in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for the period September 13, 1982, to September 17, 1982, and for such further time as may be required to complete unfinished business, pursuant to 28 U. S. C. § 294(a), is ordered entered on the minutes of this Court, pursuant to 28 U. S. C. § 295.
